title: Random Entity Spawner
description: A vanilla data pack that spawns random entities every 30 seconds, injecting endless chaos, surprises, and wildlife into your Minecraft world!
body:
**Random Entity Spawner** is a simple yet addictive Minecraft data pack that keeps your world alive with dynamic entity generation.
Every 30 seconds, a random entity spawns somewhere in the loaded chunks of your world. This could be a wandering villager, a curious fox, a hostile zombie, a floating item, or even rare mobs like phantoms or axolotls – all pulled from Minecraft's vanilla entity pool for pure unpredictability!
Key Features:
- **Precise Timing**: Exactly every 30 seconds (20 ticks per second in MC), using reliable scoreboard timers – no lag or desyncs.
Ideal for survival servers, creative farms, or anyone bored of static worlds. Watch your plains turn into a mob party or your caves fill with unexpected guests!
- **Twilight Forest Support Version:** This variant includes additional entity types from the Twilight Forest mod when the mod is installed, seamlessly blending modded creatures into the random spawn pool for even more variety in Twilight Forest biomes.
